Body.Content:
The following updates were made to the Azure portal in December 2018:

Compute

  • Updated experience for virtual machine creation and management

​Security

  • General availability of the Azure Security Center network map
  • Updated Security Policy page
  • Updated experience for access control (IAM)

Management tools

  • Updates to Azure Site Recovery

For more details, see the blog post.
